title: Fast-fashion giant Shein's shares drop 9% in Hong Kong market debut
summary: Shein debuted on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on September 1, with shares falling about 9% from the IPO price of HK$48.56. By September 3, shares fell further to HK$46 (-5.15%). Market cap at listing is ~$26.5B, far below the $100B peak valuation in 2022. IPO raised $1.74B at a fraction of peak valuation.
why: 希音港股上市即破发，估值从峰值缩水75%，是近期港股最受关注的IPO事件；9月3日继续下跌至HK$46，说明市场对快时尚增长放缓及估值的担忧持续；延续报道：上市后跌势未停

title: ADP: US private payrolls added just 38,000 in August, below 47,000 estimate; Fed September rate hike odds fall
summary: Private sector employment rose by only 38,000 in August per ADP, the smallest gain since January 2026, below the ~47,000 consensus estimate. Manufacturing shed 17,000 jobs. Markets rose on the weak data as Fed rate hike odds for September fell sharply; US Treasury yields pulled back from 3-year highs and the Dow rose ~300 points.
why: ADP就业大幅低于预期，9月加息概率骤降，美债收益率从三年高位回落，利好科技股估值；弱就业数据削弱加息预期，对持仓美股（NVDA、PLTR等）的sell put策略有利；注意明日(9月4日)正式非农就业报告(NFP)公布
source: Fox Business (ADP官方数据，非白名单媒体；数据本身来自ADP官方报告 mediacenter.adp.com)

title: Bank Plans on CLARITY Act Send Circle and Coinbase Shares Lower
summary: Circle (CRCL) and Coinbase (COIN) shares fell on September 1 as major US banks including Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Santander announced plans to issue a joint stablecoin under the CLARITY Act framework, posing a direct competitive threat to Circle's USDC stablecoin.
why: 大型银行联合发行稳定币对Circle USDC市场份额构成竞争威胁；CRCL为持仓标的，尽管USDC占稳定币交易量近70%创历史记录，银行竞争是最大风险因子；关注GENIUS Act/CLARITY Act监管落地节奏
source: Yahoo Finance (非白名单媒体，稳定币竞争威胁已由CoinDesk多次报道交叉确认)

title: US Army awards $192M to Palantir, Anduril for TITAN production; Palantir wins $127M
summary: The US Army awarded Palantir $127M and Anduril $65M in TITAN production contracts, covering 8 ground-based AI battlefield intelligence systems to be delivered over 18 months. Despite the contract, PLTR stock fell 6% on September 2 as investors sold on valuation concerns (~144x earnings).
why: Palantir持续斩获美军AI核心合同，TITAN是下一代战场AI情报系统；但股价在高估值(144倍PE)下跌6%说明短期超买；对sell put策略，高估值背景下隐含波动率偏高，需审慎判断行权价设置；已通过Defense News/Army Times/AFCEA等多个防务媒体交叉确认
source: Defense News (非白名单媒体，已通过5+防务媒体交叉确认，合同金额一致)

title: 雷军公布小米汽车9月购车权益：SU7/YU7享3年0息或6000元保险补贴，SU7 Ultra赠4.9万礼包
summary: 9月1日雷军公布小米汽车9月购车政策（至10月7日）：SU7/YU7系列限时权益2选1（3年0息 or 6000元保险补贴+低息）；YU7定制新车科技套装优惠价0.65万；SU7 Ultra提供价值4.9万元礼包含碳纤维套件、X小米HAD辅助驾驶及5年免费保养。
why: 小米汽车9月促销政策维持竞争力；SU7/YU7交付节奏是1810.HK汽车业务营收的核心驱动；关注9月交付量数据以评估汽车业务对小米集团整体估值的贡献
source: CNMO / Sohu（非白名单；雷军微博为第一手来源，多媒体转载一致）
